pdf.title: Hays Travel Branch Desk Guide — Cruise, Beach & Vista Quick Reference

sections.heading: 1. Veteran Consultant Destination & Cabin Tips (For All Branch Staff & Apprentices)
sections.content: When families ask for a soft-sand beach holiday on the Costa del Sol, remember that central Marbella beaches are stony—recommend Sol Principe Torremolinos (FAM-TOR-402 on Playamar beach) for wide, flat soft sand and a lagoon splash park. For P&O Arvia cruise bookings (Voyage Code B629C), avoid Deck 8 cabins 8201-8245 due to Promenade overhang and lifeboats; recommend Deck 12 Mid-Ship Balcony (Cabin B-12404) for unobstructed sea views and 30m proximity to the central lifts.

sections.heading: 2. Why Switch from 3rd-Party Suppliers to In-House Vista Packages?
sections.content: Standard 3rd-party packages (TUI, Jet2holidays, easyJet Holidays) pay roughly 10.5% branch commission. Switching to an equivalent Hays Travel in-house Vista package saves the customer £140-£150 on the total price while boosting branch commission to ~21.8% (+£678.07 extra commission on B629C and +£341.40 on FAM-TOR-402).

sections.heading: 3. Don't Forget the 3 Golden Branch Add-Ons (Parking, Lounge & Sunny Spend FX)
sections.content: Before completing any booking in iSell, check the customer's Walk-In Card for Holiday Extras (Airport Meet & Greet Parking and Lounge passes) and issue or top up their Hays Travel Sunny Spend currency card.
